v1.0.1-preview.21
- Synchronized with the Messaging.Android dependency cleanup and the framework-free MAUI integration sweep.

v1.0.1-preview.20
- Synchronized package version with the preview.20 release.
- Added native Messaging platform integration packages: FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Android (Android) and FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Apple (iOS, macOS, Mac Catalyst).

v1.0.1-preview.19
- Synchronized package version with the preview.19 release.
- RemoteNotification now exposes Link and RemoteMessage now exposes Link. The web integration packages surface the notification's deep link (fcmOptions.link, or the legacy notification.click_action) so consumers can act on the tapped notification's target.

v1.0.1-preview.18
- Synchronized package version with the preview.18 release.

v1.0.1-preview.17
- Fixed the web integration packages (FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Browser and FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Blazor) sending the wrong FIS auth scheme on the FCM CreateRegistration request. The x-goog-firebase-installations-auth header now uses the official `FIS {token}` scheme (matching the Web JS SDK) instead of `FIS_v2 {token}`, which FCM rejected with HTTP 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. The service worker's cold-start re-registration was updated to match.
- Added a configurable default notification icon. The web integration packages now resolve relative notification icon/image/badge values to absolute URLs against the app origin, and a new DefaultNotificationIcon option (on MessagingBlazorOptions/MessagingBrowserOptions) is provisioned to the service worker as the fallback icon when the payload supplies none.

v1.0.1-preview.16
- Fixed the web integration packages (FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Browser and FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Blazor) rejecting a null RegisterOptions. RegisterAsync now honors the documented contract that options is optional (null = defaults) and falls back to the configured VAPID key instead of throwing ArgumentNullException.

v1.0.1-preview.15
- The web integration packages (FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Browser and FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Blazor) now honor their ServiceWorkerPath and ServiceWorkerScope options when registering the service worker, so consuming apps can reference the shipped service worker directly instead of vendoring a copy.

v1.0.1-preview.14
- Added web integration packages (FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Browser and FireForNet.Firebase.Messaging.Blazor) that implement the platform contracts for FID-based registration, message delivery, and permission management on the web.

v1.0.1-preview.13
- Initial release of the Firebase Messaging core package.
- FID-based FCM registration (RegisterAsync/UnregisterAsync/OnRegistered/OnUnregistered).
- Message delivery events (OnMessageReceived/OnNotificationOpened) and one-shot GetInitialMessageAsync.
- Notification permission management (GetPermissionStatusAsync/RequestPermissionAsync).
- Topic subscription (SubscribeToTopicAsync/UnsubscribeFromTopicAsync).
- Contract-driven platform contracts (IMessagingRegistrar, IMessagingEventSource, IMessagingPermissionManager, IMessagingTopicSubscriber).
